description: Send one email to one recipient: transactional (receipt, code, alert, notice; default) or opt-in marketing with category marketing. Transactional mail carries no promotions; from your own kid-safe mailbox also no bad language or sexual content and English text only. Otherwise it is refused with content_not_allowed and uses no allowance. Marketing needs proof the person asked for it (consent_source + consent_at, or a confirmed opt-in) and gets a one-click unsubscribe link; without proof it is refused with no_consent_proof. Every send is read before it goes out: sexual content, phishing or bulk mail without an unsubscribe link is refused with content_refused, sends must be a few seconds apart (sending_too_fast), and either pauses sending for 3 minutes (sending_paused). It goes out as HTML in a branded template with a text part; give text, html or both. Uses 1 email of today's allowance. Many recipients at once: send_campaign.

brand.description: This email's look; the account's brand otherwise.

category.description: Default transactional. marketing: opt-in marketing to one person who asked for it (give consent_source and consent_at).

consent_at.description: Marketing: when they opted in, ISO 8601.

consent_source.description: Marketing: where the person opted in (sign-up form URL, event, ...).

from.description: Name before the @ (e.g. hello). The domain is always email59.com. Optional.

list_id.description: Marketing only: your name for the audience.

preheader.description: Preview text shown after the subject.

reply_to.description: Optional. One address of your own (not at email59.com) where answers should go. Without it the email says replies are not received.

template.description: Layout. basic (default), code (one-time code, give code), notice (heading and one button), report (wide tables), letter (personal).

text.description: Plain-text body. Give text, html or both.

name: send_email
title: Send an email
